'''Uldas''' was an [[Ansion/Legends|Ansonian]] deity who [[Kyakhta]] believed in.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

That the diety was "with" him or his companions was an expression of good fortune.<ref name="AS" />
